summary: An emerging class of attacks where AI agents or agentic frameworks (e.g., Hermes, ARTEX) automate intrusion activities. These attacks are characterized by machine-paced iteration, adaptive execution, and verbose tooling containing natural-language comments. They often employ a breadth-first methodology, resulting in noisy but rapid compromise of cloud-native environments.
